The '''Light-air balloon''' was a balloon used to transport goods between the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]]. Some were used during the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to transport counterfeit [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] produced on [[Bogg 2]] to [[Bogg 9]].
